components.label: Notifications & OTP
components.sublabel: in-app records, conditional push, SMS/email OTP

cards.title: Authentication/session
items: Confirmed: Flutter stores access + refresh tokens in secure storage and refreshes through /api/auth/refresh-token — AuthService.initialize/_performRefresh (lib/core/auth/auth_service.dart:171-199, 648-668).
Confirmed: Express verifies JWT signature, tokenVersion, and active account state — authenticationMiddleware (Backend/src/middleware/authMiddleware.js:4-30).

cards.title: Discover eligibility
items: Confirmed: completed onboarding is required; candidates exclude self, prior actions, matches, blocks, and non-active accounts — getFeed (Backend/src/controllers/discoverController.js:238-354).

Confirmed: reciprocal age/gender/distance and profile-completion clauses are applied in SQL — reciprocalEligibilitySqlClauses/profileCompletionSqlClauses (Backend/src/services/discoverEligibilityPolicy.js:101-237).

cards.title: Match ranking
items: Confirmed: SQL compatibility scoring orders the normal feed; AI Matches ranks the full eligible set before slicing — getFeed (Backend/src/controllers/discoverController.js:367-485).

Confirmed: provider is LOCAL; deterministic weighted factors produce aiMatchScore/confidence — localAiMatch/rankCandidates (Backend/src/services/aiMatchProvider.js:38-68). No remote AI call is present on this path.

cards.title: Like -> Match
items: Confirmed: swipe upserts DiscoverAction; a reciprocal like/super-like creates Match and a direct Conversation in one transaction — swipe (Backend/src/controllers/discoverController.js:545-592).
Confirmed: conversation creation independently requires an active match and no block — create (Backend/src/controllers/conversationController.js:99-134).

cards.title: Chat/realtime
items: Confirmed: messages persist before message.created and conversation.updated Socket.IO events — send (Backend/src/controllers/messageController.js:134-161).
Confirmed: Socket.IO authenticates JWTs and checks active account/tokenVersion; presence and room subscription are in-process — attachRealtimeServer (Backend/src/realtime/realtimeHub.js:76-160).

cards.title: Account lifecycle
items: Confirmed: password re-auth deactivation invalidates sessions/devices; a signed 10-minute challenge can reactivate — deactivate/reactivate (Backend/src/controllers/accountController.js:56-86; Backend/src/controllers/authController.js:277-305).

Confirmed: OTP-confirmed deletion archives minimal data in DeletedUsers, removes relationship/profile state, anonymizes User, and increments tokenVersion — ImmediateAccountDeletionService.execute (Backend/src/services/immediateAccountDeletionService.js:11-132).

cards.title: OTP behavior
items: Confirmed: OTPs are bcrypt-hashed, expire after 10 minutes, permit five attempts, and are consumed after success — createOtp/verifyOtp (Backend/src/services/otpService.js:43-139).

Confirmed: phone OTP uses SMS; password reset/account deletion can use email. Development may log OTPs when providers are absent — sendSms/sendEmail (Backend/src/utils/sendSms.js:1-15; Backend/src/utils/sendEmail.js:2-12).

cards.title: External integrations
items: Google OAuth: implemented but disabled by tracked default GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS=skip-for-now — authController.google (Backend/src/controllers/authController.js:251-275; Backend/.env.example:65-66).

Firebase/FCM: implemented, but tracked server credentials are blank and missing native config is tolerated — firebasePushProvider.configuration (Backend/src/services/firebasePushProvider.js:3-17; Backend/.env.example:68-73).

Twilio SMS, SMTP email, and Razorpay: implemented but tracked defaults are blank; each fails closed outside development when unconfigured — sendSms, getTransport, razorpayProvider (Backend/.env.example:53-63, 79-85).

cards.title: Production configuration gaps
items: Confirmed gap: release Flutter builds require AMORA_API_BASE_URL; repository code supplies only development localhost fallbacks — AmoraApiConfig.baseUrl (lib/core/config/amora_api_config.dart:12-38).

Confirmed gap: tracked integration defaults are unconfigured; actual deployment activation cannot be established without runtime secrets, which were intentionally not inspected — Backend/.env.example:53-85.
Risk: database startup auto-applies pending migrations — assertMigrationsApplied/initializeDatabase (Backend/src/config/db.js:4-38). This analysis did not run migrations.
